newsitem.title: EGYPT: More than 2,000 Egyptian prisoners to go free.
newsitem.headline: More than 2,000 Egyptian prisoners to go free.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak has ordered the release of 2,500 prisoners who have completed at least half of their prison sentences, the government newspaper al-Akhbar said on Friday.
The gesture is to mark celebrations of the Middle East war of October 1973, when Egyptian troops crossed the Suez Canal and broke through Israeli defence lines on the east bank.
The prisoners will go free on Sunday morning, it said.
